overall_notes: Paper focuses on NLG evaluation for writing feedback generation. The ProEval framework is a key contribution - an LLM-based evaluation method for assessing feedback quality. Human evaluations were used to validate the framework annotations. Automatic metrics were used for reliability testing of generated comments.
